title: Pure Junk Synchron
summary: Pure Junk and Synchron high-speed Synchro combo build, uniting Yusei Fudo's scrap warriors with the Junk Warrior/Assault Mode engine. The deck converts Level 2 extenders and Tuners into explosive Synchro climbs through Junk Speeder, calling forth an entire fleet of Synchron Tuners to summon multi-negate bosses like Stardust Dragon and Satellite Warrior.

summary.title: Starters
points: Junk Synchron revives a Level 2 or lower monster from your GY upon Normal Summon, immediately assembling Level 5 Synchro plays with Doppelwarrior or Quillbolt Hedgehog.
Junk Converter discards itself and a Tuner to search any Synchron monster from your Deck, and revives a Tuner from your GY when used as Synchro Material.
Junk Meister reveals a Warrior or Stardust Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck to Special Summon itself from hand, searches a Junk card on summon, and can reduce a Junk monster's Level.
Junk Armor Special Summons itself from hand when added to hand by an effect, and tributes itself to Special Summon a Junk or Synchron monster from your Deck.
Synchro Fellowship adds Junk Synchron and a Junk Warrior or Stardust card from your Deck to hand, then discards 1 card.

summary.title: Opening: Junk Synchron + Doppelwarrior
steps: Normal Summon Junk Synchron and activate its effect to revive a Level 2 monster from your GY.
Special Summon Doppelwarrior from your hand upon a monster being Special Summoned from the GY.
Synchro Summon Level 5 Junk Speeder using Junk Synchron and Doppelwarrior.

Trigger both on summon: Doppelwarrior spawns two Level 1 Doppel Tokens, and Junk Speeder Special Summons up to 5 Synchron Tuners with different Levels from your Deck (such as Junk Mail, Starjunk Synchron, and Assault Synchron).
Junk Speeder locks your Extra Deck to Synchro Monsters for the turn, setting up massive multi-Synchro boards.

summary.title: Bosses & The Assault Mode Finisher
points: Junk Speeder is the ultimate engine centerpiece: on Synchro Summon, it Special Summons as many Synchron Tuners with different Levels as possible from your Deck in Defense Position.

Satellite Warrior (Level 10) targets and destroys cards the opponent controls up to the number of Synchro Monsters in your GY, gaining 1000 ATK for each, and revives up to 3 Level 8 or lower Synchros when destroyed.
Stardust Dragon tributes itself as a Quick Effect to negate and destroy any card or effect that would destroy a card on the field, reviving in the End Phase.
Junk Warrior / Assault Mode is summoned via Assault Mode Activate tributing Junk Warrior: it is completely unaffected by your opponent's monster effects and gains immense battle prowess.
Junk Destroyer destroys cards on the field up to the number of non-Tuner monsters used for its Synchro Summon.

summary.title: Spells, Traps & Support
points: Duel Evolution - Assault Zone searches an Assault Mode card on activation, and allows Assault Mode Activate to tribute a monster directly from the Extra Deck.
Junk Signal is a Quick-Play Spell that tributes a monster to summon a Junk Warrior card or prevents opponent activations in response to your Synchro Summon.
Starjunk Synchron summons itself alongside a Level 2 or lower monster from the GY, treating itself as any Synchron Tuner for Synchro Summons.
Synchro Emergency is a Trap that can be activated from your hand when going second if the opponent controls a monster, Special Summoning monsters from hand and Deck.

allow.Stardust Dragon: Junk Signal, Junk Meister, Junk Mail and Synchro Fellowship all name or count Stardust; it's the classic Junk Synchron finisher.

main: Junk Meister
2026 support. Reveals a Warrior or Stardust Synchro to summon itself; summoned, searches a Junk card and lowers a Junk's Level.
Junk Armor
2026 support. Summons itself when searched; Tributes itself to pull a Junk or Synchron from the Deck; shields your Warrior Synchros.
Starjunk Synchron
Newest support. Summons itself with a Level 2 or lower from the GY, and counts as any Synchron Tuner.
Junk Synchron
Normal Summoned: revives a Level 2 or lower from the GY.
Junk Converter
Discards with a Tuner to search a Synchron; as material, revives a Tuner.
Assault Sonic Warrior
Summons itself next to Junk Warrior or its cards; searches a Synchron or Assault Mode Activate.
Full-Speed Warrior
Summoned: searches Junk Synchron or a Junk Warrior Spell/Trap.
Junk Mail
Level 1 Tuner that revives from the GY next to a Warrior, Synchron or Stardust Synchro.
Scrap Synchron
Counts as any Synchron and can be material from the hand.
Assault Synchron
Summons itself from the hand as a Level 2 Tuner.
Doppelwarrior
Generic: joins when a monster is revived; as material, makes two Tokens.
Quillbolt Hedgehog
Generic Level 2 that revives itself next to a Tuner.
Junk Warrior/Assault Mode
Assault Mode Activate's target: unaffected by their monster effects.
Synchro Fellowship
Adds Junk Synchron and a Junk Warrior or Stardust card, then discards.
Junk Signal
Quick-Play: Tributes to summon a Junk Warrior card, or negates a response to your Synchro.
Over Tuning
Generic: summons a Tuner from the hand, Deck or GY.
Duel Evolution - Assault Zone
Field Spell: searches an Assault Mode card and lets Assault Mode Activate Tribute from the Extra Deck.

Tributes Junk Warrior to summon Junk Warrior/Assault Mode.
Synchro Emergency
Trap you can flip from the hand going second: summons from the hand, then a Synchron from the Deck.
